requirements.description: The user prefers energy class C or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through A4, B, and C.

The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. The 60-occupant capacity is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided. Energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns, and Turin is handled by the Location Agent.
User prefers the building to be near public transport. Expression of proximity, so threshold set at the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71).
A university student residence clearly needs nearby education facilities (universities/schools). Threshold set at the 75th percentile (75.14, rounded to 75).

output.explanation: Filters offices (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 850 m², within 3.0 km of 45.0677551, 7.6824892, energy class A1–C, mobility score >= 71 and education score >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the given coordinates, nearest first. No LIMIT applied.
